description: This file contains a shell script implementing a data check mechanism for U-Boot with the datachk patchset, specifically for device upgrades involving kernel and root filesystem partitions in embedded systems. It handles calculating offsets, sizes, and checksums, updating U-Boot environment variables, and performing flash memory writes for a failsafe upgrade process.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_failsafe_datachk
methods.description: Main function performing data check, environment update, and flash write operations for failsafe upgrade in embedded devices.
